acorn.note: Acorns drop through autumn; gathered nuts are dried and kept over winter for flour and Korean acorn jelly.

cep.note: Wild porcini flush after late-summer rain and peak in early autumn; in Yunnan and the Mexican highlands they come with the rainy season.

chestnut.note: Nuts fall from late September; cured chestnuts keep cool for a couple of months, carrying them through the winter roasting season.

truffle.note: Prized winter truffles: Alba white from October, Périgord black from December to February; in the Gulf and North Africa desert truffles follow the late-winter rains.
